vectors.name: worker_handraise_html_escaping
vectors.why_this_vector_exists: This is the only vector that distinguishes trueopen-cjson-v1 from Go's encoding/json default. json.Marshal escapes '<' '>' '&' to \u003c \u003e \u0026 unless SetEscapeHTML(false) is called (node d8792e6 x/shared/types/canonical_json.go:19). No other language does that, so an implementation that leaves Go's default on agrees with every other vector in this file and disagrees here. That divergence happened in the wild, and ordinary task identifiers - bech32 addresses, lowercase hex, dotted NATS subjects - contain none of these three characters, so no other fixture can catch it.
